comparison.objective: Advance a sheath over a guidewire, seat it, then withdraw the wire without losing it; candidate commissions a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Coaxial sliding, flexible-wire retention, and staged withdrawal versus hex-key alignment, rotary tuning, stabilization, locking, and impact evaluation.
comparison.success_condition: Sheath seated and wire removed with all objects released versus two safe stopping cycles and retained collar setting.
comparison.reason: Guidewire/sheath manipulation is an insertion-and-retention task, not dynamic commissioning. Specs are empty; seating tolerance, wire-loss definition, and phantom damage criteria are absent.
